segment one.title: upay, Falcon Group sign agreement on salary disbursement
segment one.desc:
upay, a leading mobile financial service provider in the country signed an agreement with Falcon group recently to facilitate the Falcon Group disburse monthly salaries to their employees through upay.

Sydul H Khandker, Managing Director and CEO of upay and Mahtab Uddin Ahmed Chowdhury, Chairman & Managing Director of Falcon Group signed the agreement on behalf of their respective organizations held at the head office of upay Gulshan.

Among others, Ziaur Rahman, Chief Strategy Officer, Md. Nur-E-Alam Siddiquee, Chief Financial Officer, Saad Mohammad Faizul Karim, Director, Business Sales, Biplab Banerjee, Director, Distribution Sales and S.M. Wahid Ferdous, Senior Manager Business Sales of upay and Dulal Chandra Sarker, General Manager of Falcon Group were present at the signing ceremony.

upay, a subsidiary of United Commercial Bank launched its operation in March 2021 aiming to provide mobile financial services to the people of all walks of life.
